Forms and FormData

FormData collects successful named form controls into key/value entries, including file objects. A submit
listener can validate and send this data without a full page navigation.
Form එJක් name තිJයන enabled controls වල values FormData එJකන් ලබාගෙන්න පුළුවන්. Submit event එJක් preventDefault කර browser navigation නවත්වලා data API එකකට යවන්න. Server-side validation අනිවාර්යයි.
Submit a registration form or upload an image.

Named fields එකතු කර FormData හදා server එකට යවන්න. Server එJකන් ඒ data validate කරනවා.
Expected result: With a valid form and named email control, submitting logs its value.
Interview question: Why not set multipart Content-Type manually with FormData?

Answer: The browser sets the multipart boundary when sending FormData; overriding it can break
parsing.
Remember: Name gives key; FormData collects.
